notes.title: Bug fix on level 8
notes.content:
There is a bug on level 8 that doesn't allow the player to get the chests.

notes.title: Bugfix for All Levels Completed Achievement
notes.content:
One user says that after he completed level 8, he got the All Levels Completed achievement.
Now the game has 15 levels, not 8 when it was in early access version.
The bug is fixed now.
